player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Tower of Hanoi with {num_disks} disks.
You have to move the disks from tower A to tower C.
To move a disk, type the source tower and the target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Note that you can only move the top disk of a tower, and that a bigger disk cannot be placed on a smaller disk.
At each turn, submit one move.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Nge me tuba nde kisika ya kubasisa to nzozulu yina nge ke sosa kele ve mbote.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Nge mekaka kukatula diske mosi na nzo ya nda yina vandaka ve ti kima.
invalid_move.same_tower: Nge mekaka kunata diske mosi na nzozulu yina.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Nge mekaka kutula diske ya nene na zulu ya diskete mosi ya fyoti.

outcome.win: Congratulations! You solved the Tower of Hanoi puzzle.
outcome.turn_limit: Bo me lungisa kitini ya nsuka yina bo fwete balula. Nge tulaka mbote {pct}% na kati ya ba diske yonso na Nzo-zulu C.
